chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: His 1956 French Columbia record released only in England
summary: Dickenson shows a rare record made in 1956 and released in England, including one of his own numbers, What Have You Done With the Key to Your Heart.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
